content: {"question":"What is the minimum monthly payment that GitLab France S.A.S. will cover for remote work expenses such as wifi, heating, and electricity?","answer":"GitLab France S.A.S. will cover a minimum payment of €57.20 per month for remote work expenses.","evidence":"This means that you shall receive a minimum payment of €57.20 per month, up to the limits set out in our [expenses policy](/handbook/finance/expenses/) and provided that your remote work expenses actually incurred monthly reach at least this amount."}
